verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a native bill-pay product covering the full AP flow. Invoice capture uses OCR with claimed 99% line-item accuracy, plus two- and three-way matching. Bills fall under the same approval workflows as other spend: they can be approved in the UI or CLI, and Ramp agents learn from past invoices and escalate risky ones. Vendors can be paid per bill by ACH, check, wire, card, and more, including via the POST /bills API. missing for 10: detailed documentation of bill-specific approval routing rules (e.g., by amount or approver chain), independent or hands-on corroboration of the AP workflow.
